Course Hero Section:
- Category & difficulty badge: 'DATA & FINANCIAL MODELING' badge with subtle indigo background, along with 'ADVANCED' red accent badge and 'BICE CERTIFIED TRACK' badge.
- Course Title: 'Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling' (bold, high-contrast, clean corporate typography).
- Subtitle: 'From spreadsheet basics to automation-grade Excel for enterprise analysts. Master nested lookups, automated Power Query ETL pipelines, and C-Suite presentation dashboards.'

Key Metrics Ribbon:
- Clean 3-col micro KPI ribbon: '32 Hours' on-demand video, '96 Downloadable' models & workbooks, 'Lifetime' access with mobile sync.

'What you'll learn' Section:
- Card with subtle slate border and rounded-xl styling.
- Title: 'What you'll learn in this masterclass' (8 Core Competencies).
- Compact 2-column or structured checklist with crisp green checkmark icons:
  1. Dynamic lookup formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH-MATCH, CHOOSE)
  2. Multi-table financial models with automated scenarios & Goal Seek
  3. Cleanse & merge messy enterprise ERP datasets via Power Query M-code
  4. Interactive Pivot Tables, timeline slicers, and calculated items
  5. McKinsey-style KPI dashboards with custom conditional formatting
  6. Reusable LAMBDA functions and dynamic array manipulation (FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE)
  7. Automated weekly report routines via VBA/macro scripts
  8. Financial audit trail calculation chains and circular dependency detection

Skills & Tags Covered:
- Horizontal flex chips: 'XLOOKUP & Dynamic Arrays', 'Power Query ETL', 'Financial Modeling', 'Pivot Tables & Slicers', 'VBA Automation', 'Dashboard UI Design', 'SUMIFS Logic'.

'This course includes' Summary Box:
- Icon list featuring: 32 hours on-demand HD video, 96 downloadable corporate models (.xlsx, .pbix), 4 real-world capstone portfolio reviews, Verified BICE Certificate of Completion, Accessible on iOS, Android & Desktop, 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

'Course Curriculum' Section (Accordion):
- Header: 'Course Curriculum' with '4 sections • 24 modules • 96 lessons • 32h 15m total'.
- Section 1 (EXPANDED): 'Section 1: Modern Excel Architecture & Dynamic Formulas' (6 lessons • 4h 30m).
  List of lessons:
  - 1. Course Architecture & Sanitized Enterprise Data Files (12:40) [Play icon, 'Free Preview' indigo badge]
  - 2. Dynamic Arrays & The Death of Legacy VLOOKUP: Deep Dive (24:15) [Play icon, 'Free Preview' indigo badge]
  - 3. Two-Way Matrix Matching: Combining INDEX, MATCH, and XMATCH (38:20) [Lock icon, 38:20]
  - 4. Array Extraction: FILTER, SORT, SORTBY, and UNIQUE with Multiple Conditions (29:10) [Lock icon]
  - 5. Formula Error Resiliency: Defensive Logic with IFERROR, ISNUMBER, and SWITCH (18:45) [Lock icon]
  - 6. Capstone Project 1: Multi-Tier Cohort Retention & ARR Modeling Sheet (45:00) [Lock icon, assignment badge]
- Section 2 (COLLAPSED): 'Section 2: Institutional Financial Modeling & Scenario Sensitivity' (8 lessons • 8h 15m, chevron down).
- Section 3 (COLLAPSED): 'Section 3: Power Query & Automated Multi-Source ETL Workflows' (10 lessons • 11h 20m, chevron down).
- Section 4 (COLLAPSED): 'Section 4: Executive Dashboard Design, VBA Automation & Final Portfolio' (8 lessons • 9h 10m, chevron down).

Instructor Spotlight Card:
- Card featuring CA Rohan Mehta: avatar/photo placeholder, 'Principal Financial Architect & Former Deloitte Strategy Lead', '4.9 Instructor Rating', '42,000+ Students', '14 Years Enterprise Practice', short bio describing Wall Street and Fortune 100 advisory experience.

Student Ratings & Reviews Section:
- Big 4.8 rating highlight with star visualization and breakdown bars (5 stars: 84%, 4 stars: 12%, 3 stars: 3%, 2 stars: 1%, 1 star: 0%).
- 2 Authentic executive review cards:
  - Card 1: Samantha Patel (Lead Financial Analyst, Deloitte): 'The XLOOKUP and Power Query workflow alone saved my team 15+ hours weekly. The capstone financial model is identical to what we use on live engagements.'
  - Card 2: David Kalu (FP&A Team Lead, FinTech): 'Clear, structured, zero fluff. The breakdown of dynamic arrays and scenario matrices made complex model audits second nature for our corporate treasury group.'

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ Accordion):
- Compact expandable items:
  - 'Do I need prior financial modeling or VBA experience?'
  - 'Is the certificate recognized for corporate training reimbursement?'
  - 'Does this course cover Excel for Mac or only Windows?'
  - 'How long do I maintain access to the sandbox files and video lessons?'
